decisions.reason: This low-pile decorative carpet sits outside the firm's core furniture-making knowledge and is likely sourced from partners, which limits how well the firm can learn from it, but as a recent addition styling its collections it will probably stay for now.
The hand-knotted wool silk carpet suits the firm's premium material and craftsmanship positioning, so it supports the brand even though textile know-how is not central to the firm.
As another low-pile decorative carpet with limited links to the firm's own knowledge base, it faces some risk of being trimmed from the rug range, but it is too early to drop it.

This low-pile carpet overlaps with other rugs in the range and lies away from the firm's core competences, making it a candidate for consolidation, though one year on the market is too short to judge.
The corner bench builds directly on the firm's upholstery, material and customization expertise, so the firm can read its early results and refine it.
The swivel shell chair line with several models draws on core seating know-how and designer collaborations, and serves both residential and contract customers, which strongly favours keeping it.
